subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub adopt public `mode=prefix|exact` search modes and matching `clawhub search --prefix/--exact` flags, with the proposed deterministic semantics and 200-result cap?
rationale: This is a new user-facing HTTP and CLI capability rather than a repair to an established contract, so implementation quality alone cannot determine the permanent interface.

options.title: Sponsor this API and CLI contract
options.body: Approve the two modes and 200-result cap, contingent on real Convex backend proof of the documented semantics.

options.title: Choose a different discovery interface
options.body: Request a narrower or separate registry-listing design before accepting new public search-mode parameters.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Leave the existing relevance-ranked search contract unchanged until a maintainer prioritizes registry-style discovery.

recommendation.title: Sponsor this API and CLI contract
recommendation.body: Approve the two modes and 200-result cap, contingent on real Convex backend proof of the documented semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the concrete implementation contact, though final product approval should come from a repository decision-maker.
